package.name: Pimp My FreeCAD
package.description: Extra modeling tools for PartDesign and Part. Rail Pipe / Rail Groove: sweep a flat face or closed sketch along a guide curve to a second profile or a free end, added to or cut out of the Body; edit the guide on screen with a Move gizmo, cable-like neighbours and the native PartDesign preview. Magic Pad: Pad and Pocket in one tool with a draggable arrow, Up to modes, taper, twist and several faces at once (also in the Part workbench). Magic Loft / Magic Loft Cut: a clean loft through closed profiles with selected or automatic guides. Dome: raise a flat face into a cap tangent to its neighbouring faces. Body Sweep / Body Sweep Cut (experimental): sweep a solid tool along a path and cut solids with the swept volume.

workbench.name: Pimp My FreeCAD
workbench.description: Rail Pipe / Rail Groove, Magic Loft, Dome, Body Sweep (experimental); the tools also appear in the toolbars of PartDesign and Part.
